scope: Synthetic-only bounded CPU forward/backward feasibility benchmark; no ECG files accessed.

variants.name: shared_per_lead_cnn_lstm_48x1000
variants.architecture:
SharedLeadCNNLSTM(
  (cnn): Sequential(
    (0): Conv2d(1, 4, kernel_size=(5, 9), stride=(2, 4), padding=(2, 4), bias=False)
    (1): GroupNorm(2, 4, eps=1e-05, affine=True)
    (2): ReLU()
    (3): Conv2d(4, 8, kernel_size=(3, 5), stride=(2, 2), padding=(1, 2), bias=False)
    (4): GroupNorm(2, 8, eps=1e-05, affine=True)
    (5): ReLU()
    (6): AdaptiveAvgPool2d(output_size=(4, 125))
  )
  (lstm): LSTM(384, 32, batch_first=True)
  (head): Sequential(
    (0): Dropout(p=0.25, inplace=False)
    (1): Linear(in_features=32, out_features=5, bias=True)
  )
)

variants.name: lead_channel_separable_cnn_lstm_120x1120
variants.architecture:
LeadChannelSeparableCNNLSTM(
  (cnn): Sequential(
    (0): Conv2d(12, 12, kernel_size=(5, 5), stride=(2, 4), padding=(2, 2), groups=12, bias=False)
    (1): Conv2d(12, 8, kernel_size=(1, 1), stride=(1, 1), bias=False)
    (2): GroupNorm(4, 8, eps=1e-05, affine=True)
    (3): ReLU()
    (4): Conv2d(8, 8, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(2, 2), padding=(1, 1), groups=8, bias=False)
    (5): Conv2d(8, 16, kernel_size=(1, 1), stride=(1, 1), bias=False)
    (6): GroupNorm(4, 16, eps=1e-05, affine=True)
    (7): ReLU()
    (8): Conv2d(16, 16, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(2, 2), padding=(1, 1), groups=16, bias=False)
    (9): Conv2d(16, 24, kernel_size=(1, 1), stride=(1, 1), bias=False)
    (10): GroupNorm(4, 24, eps=1e-05, affine=True)
    (11): ReLU()
    (12): AdaptiveAvgPool2d(output_size=(4, 70))
  )
  (lstm): LSTM(96, 32, batch_first=True)
  (head): Sequential(
    (0): Dropout(p=0.2, inplace=False)
    (1): Linear(in_features=32, out_features=5, bias=True)
  )
)

limitations: Synthetic random tensors and fixed targets are reused; losses do not measure ECG performance.
Only 10 measured steps after 2 warmups; long-run thermal throttling and competing load can change estimates.
Epoch and multi-epoch numbers extrapolate training-step mean only and are not total wall-time guarantees.
RSS is sampled after steps and excludes instantaneous peaks and child processes; successive variants share a process/allocator.
Batch 32 was not probed because this 8 GiB machine has limited available memory.
Shared-lead variant concatenates per-lead vertical CNN features; separable variant mixes lead channels after its first depthwise convolution.
Rendered-image sequence positions are spatial positions with documented image geometry; they are not recovered calibrated waveform samples.
